arguments.summary: The database is not the issue as it was up the whole time. The ingress idle timeout of 30 seconds caused the 502s. The read replica is 12 minutes behind. The primary shows a backlog of 1204 failed jobs, with 47 malformed rows. The failed jobs include a mix of 'failed' and 'timeout' statuses, with specific timeout errors. The top 5 job types and any patterns in the pgbouncer logs will be investigated next. Restarting pgbouncer may be considered. The backlog should be prioritized for resolution.
